detailZones.title: Operating room
detailZones.description: Follow the operating table, surgical light, anesthesia, monitoring and instrument hardware.

detailZones.title: Scrub and gowning
detailZones.description: Inspect scrub sinks, faucets, protective clothing, glove storage and clean-room cabinets.

detailZones.title: Sterile storage
detailZones.description: Explore the instrument cabinet, sealed trays, pass-through window and clean corridor fixtures.

detailZones.title: Recovery ward
detailZones.description: Inspect recovery beds, monitoring, privacy, outlets, bedside storage and the glazed partition.

detailZones.title: Theatre equipment
detailZones.description: Study the mobile tray, equipment casters, tabletop surfaces and connected room hardware.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized operating-theatre photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 109 independently pointable room, equipment, fixture and visible part anchors across 5 bounded zones. Patient identity, diagnosis, medication names, procedure steps, outcomes, sterile-state claims, brands, readable screen content and hidden functions were excluded.
